findings.explanation: After funding 100 and an unsolicited donation of 100, escrow balance is 200. The all_balance rule pays all 200 to bob at release, instead of paying the committed 100 and leaving the donated 100 locked. This increases entitlement in violation of R6; the same payout also violates R3's committed-amount rule and R4's cumulative cap of 100. These are consequences of the single all-balance mismatch.

summary: Donations are paid out, increasing entitlement and exceeding the committed cap.
